family: ORISON 007 closed periodic analytic-frame rounded-rectangle sweep
native_axes: right-handed Z-up; primary centreline plane XZ with Y undulation

topology.last_first_ring_connection: modulo indices, 36 longitudinal seam edges each incident on 2 faces

contract_identity.all_world_vertices: same ordered index coordinates as recipe, distance <=2e-7 m
contract_identity.all_faces: equal multiplicity of unoriented index cycles; local winding and positive world volume checked separately
contract_identity.metadata: all station centres/tangents/normals/binormals and parameters checked against declared recipe construction

frame.method: periodic analytic fixed Y-reference projection with periodic roll; NOT RMF or parallel transport

numerical_intersections.nonadjacent_BVH: shared-vertex triangle pairs excluded; remaining overlap candidates reject
numerical_intersections.near_coplanar: bidirectional point-to-plane <=5e-8 m, abs normal dot >=1-1e-7, projected SAT positive overlap >1e-8 m

native_GLB_correspondence.oriented_triangle_coordinate_multiset: exact equality after native-to-glTF axis rotation

provenance: Generic component traversal, BVH, float64 world signed-volume and bidirectional near-coplanar SAT adapted from study-006/source/check.py.
Generic accessor decode and payload mutation patterns adapted from study-006/source/check_glb.py and test_faults.py; 007 adds stable failure codes and failure identities.
Periodic seam, frame, genus, curvature/clearance and 007 station-local fault construction are family-specific, not folded-sheet constraints.
not_verified: adjacent noncoplanar foldover as a general arbitrary-mesh theorem
